description: This file defines the Pagination class within the Opencart admin controller common namespace. It provides functionality to generate pagination links for the admin interface, including methods to calculate page numbers, build URLs, and render pagination views.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: A class responsible for generating pagination controls for the admin interface, handling calculation of page links, URLs, and producing the HTML output of the pagination component.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates pagination HTML based on provided settings, calculating total pages, current page, URL structure, and constructing navigational links.
